Inside it, in the lower half, is a rounded hollow upright RING with TWO diagonal crossings forming X. The ring has a CENTER vertical stem extending below; a short horizontal crosses that stem below the ring, and the stem ENDS on a second longer horizontal baseline. Preserve four white ring counters produced by X, the two lower horizontals, and the detached outer enclosing right stroke. Do not connect ring to enclosure.
